why: a recently-opened file is a files-view row: type mark, size, folder, and how long since you opened it — seeded so the contract is checked wherever the xbel file exists
setup:
d="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}" && mkdir -p "$d" "$HOME/.local/share" "$HOME/oxyrec-9d3f1" && printf 'recent fixture
' > "$HOME/oxyrec-9d3f1/needle-recent-9d3f1.txt" && u="$HOME/oxyrec-9d3f1/needle-recent-9d3f1.txt" && { command -v cygpath >/dev/null && u="$(cygpath -m "$u")"; true; } && printf '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<xbel version="1.0" xmlns:bookmark="http://www.freedesktop.org/standards/desktop-bookmarks">
<bookmark href="file://%s" added="2020-01-01T00:00:00Z" modified="2020-01-01T00:00:00Z" visited="2020-01-01T00:00:00Z"/>
</xbel>
' "$u" | tee "$d/recently-used.xbel" > "$HOME/.local/share/recently-used.xbel"
